chunks: And it is narrated from Al-Rida (peace be upon him) that he said:
"There is no speech (or statement) except with action, and no action except with intention, and no intention except with conformity to the Sunnah."
ai.seo_question: What are the three conditions for a religious act to be considered valid according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: In the context of fasting jurisprudence, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) establishes a rigorous triad of validity: speech necessitates action, action requires sincere intention (niyyah), and intention is only authentic if it aligns with the Prophetic Sunnah. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis that ritual acts are not merely mechanical but must be rooted in correct theological understanding and prophetic precedent to be accepted. It serves as a foundational principle for distinguishing between mere outward compliance and true spiritual devotion.
